# invade.lol

> invade.lol is a League of Legends statistics website and the home of Invade, a free desktop companion app for Windows and macOS. It shows player profiles (rank, match history, a 0 to 100 score for every game), champion statistics computed from its own collection of ranked games, tier lists, ladders, and professional players and teams in solo queue.

All statistics come from ranked games read through Riot Games' official API and stored by invade.lol. Champion statistics default to the current patch and the Emerald+ rank group. Patch names follow Riot's current naming (patch 26.22 is game version 16.22). invade.lol is not endorsed by Riot Games.

## Players

- [Player profile](https://invade.lol/Name-TAG): a player's rank and LP, LP history, recent match history and champion pool. The address is the Riot ID with `#` replaced by `-` (Riot ID `Faker#KR1` is `/Faker-KR1`).
- Profile tabs: `/Name-TAG/matches` (full match history), `/Name-TAG/champions` (champion statistics), `/Name-TAG/mastery` (champion mastery), `/Name-TAG/friends` (players they queue with), `/Name-TAG/lens` (their recent games in one role rated domain by domain: laning, farming, teamfighting, vision, objectives, survival and consistency).
- [Match page](https://invade.lol/Name-TAG/match/EUW1_1234567890): one game seen by one of its players: scoreboard, gold, timeline, builds and the Invade score of all ten players.
- [Search](https://invade.lol/search?q=Name%23TAG): opens a player, a champion, a pro or a team.
- The Invade score rates one player's game from 0 to 100 against the Emerald pace of their role and against the lobby. About 41 is an average Emerald game, 60 and more is very good, 80 and more exceptional.

## Champions

- [Tier list](https://invade.lol/tier-list): every champion of every role ranked by tier (S+ to D) and win rate. One role: `/tier-list?role=top|jungle|mid|bot|support`.
- [Champion page](https://invade.lol/champions/ahri): a champion's build, runes, skill order, counters and statistics in a role. Tabs: `/champions/<slug>/build`, `/runes`, `/items`, `/matchups`, `/statistics`, `/pros`. Role: `?role=mid`.
- [Matchup](https://invade.lol/champions/ahri/matchups/zed): two champions in the same lane, side by side.
- [Item tier list](https://invade.lol/tier-list/items), [rune tier list](https://invade.lol/tier-list/runes), [duo tier list](https://invade.lol/tier-list/duos) (bot lane; `?lane=mid` and `?lane=top` pair with the jungle), [ARAM tier list](https://invade.lol/tier-list/aram).
- [Stats](https://invade.lol/stats): every champion of a role in one table, with views for the early game, game length, first blood, items, regions and the patch (`?view=early|length|firstblood|items|regions|patch`).
- [Patch notes](https://invade.lol/patch): each patch's champion, item and mode changes, with how the changed champions did. One patch: `/patch/26.22`.
- [New Dawn](https://invade.lol/new-dawn): Riot's 2027 update to League of Legends, from Riot's own posts and videos: what the teaser showed, what changes in January, what people ask and what Riot has not answered. [Every Riot post and video](https://invade.lol/new-dawn/posts) about it, newest first, and the [leaks and rumours](https://invade.lol/new-dawn/rumours) with their sources and Riot's answers.

## Ladders

- [Solo/Duo ladder](https://invade.lol/leaderboards/solo): Challenger, Grandmaster and Master of a server ranked by LP. Server: `?region=euw|eune|na|kr|br|lan|las|jp|oce|tr|vn|tw|sea|me|ru`.
- [Flex ladder](https://invade.lol/leaderboards/flex): ranked flex players and who they queue with.
- [One-tricks](https://invade.lol/leaderboards/one-tricks): apex players with at least half of their ranked games on one champion.
- [Pro ladder](https://invade.lol/leaderboards/pros): professional players ranked by the LP of their best solo queue account.

## Esports

- [Esports](https://invade.lol/esports): professional matches live and next, and the leagues.
- [Leagues](https://invade.lol/leagues) and one league: `/league/<slug>` (for example `/league/lec`).
- [Pros](https://invade.lol/pros): professional players with their solo queue accounts; one league: `/pros?league=lck`.
- [Teams](https://invade.lol/teams). One pro: `/pro/<slug>`; one team: `/team/<slug>`.

## Desktop app

- [Invade for desktop](https://invade.lol/app): a free League of Legends companion app for Windows and macOS: objective timers and the player's pace during a game, runes set in champ select, a score for every game, and automatic clips of the best moments.
- [Release notes](https://invade.lol/app/changelog); one version: `/app/changelog/0.3.8`.

## About

- [Contact](https://invade.lol/contact): the Discord server for help and feedback, and the X account for news.
- [Privacy policy](https://invade.lol/privacy) and [legal notice and terms](https://invade.lol/legal).
